author.name: Linden Street Bakery
author.headline: Neighbourhood bakery · Sourdough, cakes and coffee since 1998

text: Our autumn menu starts Monday: pumpkin sourdough, apple crumb cake and a soup of the week. The first loaves come out of the oven at 7, so come early if you want a warm one. Thank you for all your suggestions!
